title: Stage 31.7.24 Runtime Manifest
author: Antigravity Pair Programmer & Knowledge Manager

implemented_components.name: SemanticIntentAndDemandExtractor
implemented_components.responsibility: Decomposes questions into conjunctive atomic demands, identifies multi-state aspect goals (closed/open/half-open, coordination/compensation, commit/abort/crash), and enforces aspect completeness criteria without closed word lists.

implemented_components.name: PropositionDiscourseFilter
implemented_components.responsibility: Classifies candidate propositions into discourse genres (MECHANISM_EXPLANATION, HISTORICAL_TRIVIA, PERSONAL_DECLARATION, EVASIVE_DEFLECTION, AMBIGUOUS_STATEMENT, SPECULATIVE_ASSERTION) and prevents non-operative sentences from claiming operative status.

implemented_components.name: MorphologicalCircularityAnalyzer
implemented_components.responsibility: Detects tautological circular reasoning across 11 unified Portuguese cognate families without information gain, distinguishing valid technical definitions from empty subject-predicate repetitions.

implemented_components.name: DemandPropositionNexusBipartiteMatcher
implemented_components.responsibility: Performs exact bipartite matching between each atomic question demand and candidate technical propositions, checking operational mechanism validity, failure/recovery handling, and preventing single-word cross-satisfaction.

implemented_components.name: StrictOntologyRelevanceAggregator
implemented_components.responsibility: Aggregates demand-level nexus evaluations into the 7 canonical classes under strict ontological precedence rules (EVASIVE -> INSUFFICIENT, AMBIGUOUS -> UNKNOWN, ANTITHESIS -> OFF_TOPIC, ADJACENT -> RELATED, AUXILIARY -> SUPPORTING, PARTIAL -> PARTIAL, FULL -> DIRECT).

invariants_verified: I-01: Deterministic evaluation (same input strictly produces same output)
I-02: Zero closed lexical catalogs for domain-specific pairs
I-03: Strict conjunctive satisfaction (100% of primary demands required for DIRECT)
I-04: Non-operative discourse genres cannot satisfy functional demands
I-05: Tautological circular explanations mapped strictly to UNKNOWN
I-06: Evasive non-technical responses mapped strictly to INSUFFICIENT
I-07: Destructive antitheses mapped strictly to OFF_TOPIC unless guarded by prevention context
I-08: Auxiliary observability mapped to SUPPORTING before entity adjacency fallthrough
I-09: Multi-state failure/crash aspects cannot be satisfied by coordinator tokens alone
I-10: Epistemic status separation preserved across all pipeline stages
I-11: Full traceability in return dictionary (demands, propositions, nexuses, rationale)
I-12: Zero backward-compatibility breaking changes to evaluate_open_domain_semantic_relevance()
I-13: Preservation of all historical benchmarks and ground truth artifacts
I-14: Representation invariance across informal, formal, and concise technical phrasings
I-15: Zero regression in canonical test suite and Reference Harness
